label: Library Package
description: Bundles a ZIP-based PHP library folder into the generated plugin and can load its autoloader.

properties.name: destination
properties.label: Destination folder
properties.help: Path inside the generated plugin, for example libraries/mpdf.

properties.name: archive
properties.label: Library ZIP archive
properties.help: ZIP the complete library folder before selecting it.

properties.name: strip_root_folder
properties.label: Remove ZIP root folder
properties.help: Useful when the archive contains one wrapper folder such as mpdf-8.2.5/.

properties.name: autoload_file
properties.label: Autoloader path
properties.help: Path relative to the destination folder, for example vendor/autoload.php or autoload.php.
